lcc_original: 永恆主說：『你幹了甚麼事？你兄弟的血有聲音從地裏向我哀叫呢。
notes: 耶和華 (YHWH, H03068) has no SN tag in the source UNV data, so 永恆主 receives no SN annotation
LCC 幹了 replaces UNV 做了 — both map to H06213 (עָשָׂה, to do/make)
LCC 哀叫 replaces UNV 哀告 — both map to H06817 (צָעַק, to cry out); morphology WTH8802 attached accordingly
LCC adds sentence-final particle 呢 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
裏 (LCC) vs 裡 (UNV) are orthographic variants; WH0127 attaches to 地 in both cases
